name: coop-connect-demo
description: Full-stack SaaS platform that digitises housing co-op operations, including a double entry bookkeeping system. Demo version of application used by brighton-rock.org. Next.js, Typescript, PostgreSQL, PWA

paragraphs: A modern web application built for Brighton Rock Housing Co-op, featuring both a public website and a comprehensive members portal for co-op management. This application is built with Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and integrates with a PostgreSQL database.
The Co-operative Connect Management App consists of two main components:
features: Public Website: A public-facing website for general information about the co-op, including:
Members Portal: A secure, authenticated area for co-op members that provides tools for co-op management, including:
Dashboard for quick access to all features
Secretary tools for meetings and correspondence
